name: Casino South African
description: South African Casino is a Royal Casino variant played in South Africa. Part of the African Casino family with face-up capture piles and opponents able to use top cards in builds. Features numerical picture card values and complex building mechanics.

overview.description: South African Casino is a Royal Casino variant played in South Africa. Part of the African Casino family with face-up capture piles and opponents able to use top cards in builds. Features numerical picture card values and complex building mechanics.

history.origins: South African Casino is the South Africa variant of the African Casino family, alongside Swazi Casino (Eswatini) and Sotho Casino (Lesotho). Documented by Faizal Asmal. The game represents the South African interpretation of this Royal Casino variant.
timeline: Current: Popular in South Africa alongside other Casino variants
history.cultural: Played throughout South Africa. The country has a rich card game tradition with multiple Casino variants. The African Casino style with face-up piles is distinctive to the region.
history.evolution: South African Casino shares the African Casino innovations: face-up capture piles, opponent access to top cards, numerical picture card values, and complex single/augmented building.

setup.players: 2-4 players. 4 players in fixed partnerships. Play anticlockwise.
setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack. Card values: 2-10=face, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1/14.
setup.dealing: Similar to other African Casino variants: 4 cards cut for layout, all cards dealt to players.

rules.objective: Capture cards from layout. Reach target score first.
rules.gameplay: Same core mechanics as Swazi/Sotho Casino: Face-up capture piles, top card available to opponents, must play one card per turn, single and augmented builds, drifting allowed, build ownership tracked.
keyRules: Opponents can use top card of your pile
Must play exactly one card per turn

strategy.basic: Standard African Casino strategy: Careful timing of captures, building when holding the capture card.
strategy.intermediate: High-value build focus, managing your pile's top card, monitoring opponent builds.
strategy.advanced: Build warfare, creating monopolies, using opponent piles, partner coordination.
tips: Control what's on top of your pile
Watch for opportunities to use opponent's top card
